A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Q-CLIP research and are fully readable, including equations, six figures, four tables, and references. Both contain nine pages; neither includes an appendix.

before.justification: v1 reports original Q-CLIP benchmark results in Tables 1-2, component ablations in Tables 3-4, and layer-depth and feature-visualization analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark experiments, ablations, and visualization results reported in v1.

M1.justification: The E-SCMA and P-SCMA adapters, parameter sharing, learnable five-level prompts, quality regression, and frame-sampling procedures remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the same video-quality tasks using LSVQ, KoNViD-1k, LIVE-VQC, YouTube-UGC, CVD2014, and LIVE-Qualcomm, with identical intra-dataset, cross-dataset, and fine-tuning coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within Tables 1 and 2 and the efficiency comparison in Figure 1. No baseline is added, removed, or replaced.

E3.justification: Both retain the same dataset sizes and splits, evaluation metrics, PEcore-L backbone, eight-frame inputs, eight-epoch training, and sampling settings for the reported experiments.

E4.justification: The sampling comparisons, SCMA-sharing and prompt ablations, layer-depth analysis, efficiency comparison, and t-SNE analysis are unchanged in Tables 1, 3-4 and Figures 1, 5-6.

E5.justification: Both report average performance over ten random splits. Run-count disclosure and uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged; no seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests are added.

E6.justification: Tables 1-4, plotted results, and reported findings are unchanged. For example, Q-CLIP-Mixed retains 0.899/0.900 SROCC/PLCC on LSVQtest in Table 1, and fine-tuned Q-CLIP retains 0.915/0.920 on KoNViD-1k in Table 2.

T1.justification: Equations (1)-(13) and their mathematical definitions are unchanged. No assumptions, derivations, propositions, or proofs are added, removed, or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about a fully VLM-based VQA framework, lightweight adaptation, five-level prompts, frame sampling, and competitive performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations of shared adaptation, sampling generalization, and t-SNE feature separation remain identical. The qualification about weaker cross-dataset LIVE-VQC performance is retained, with no new limitations or applicability boundaries.

D1.justification: Implementation disclosures remain identical: PyTorch, RTX 4090, AdamW, initial learning rate 0.001, cosine annealing, and batch size 12. No reproducibility or resource-access information is added or removed.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, cited works, reference entries, and positioning relative to previous VQA and vision-language methods remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 removes Shixin Sun and Yuanyuan Liu from the author list and adds Zhixuan Li and Wei Yang Bryan Lim. The third affiliation changes from China University of Geosciences (Wuhan) to Nanyang Technological University, and the version/date stamp updates. Body prose and section structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1-6 and Tables 1-4 retain their content, captions, formatting, and placement. The two-column layout and section pagination are unchanged.

improvement.justification: The changes concern authorship, affiliation, and version information. The scientific text, experimental evidence, mathematical content, reproducibility details, and visual presentation remain unchanged, establishing no meaningful overall quality difference.
